scopeNote: Coverage-driven provisional decisions; first measurement and phenotype section drafted. Not official examination weightings.

checks: Normal/elevated/stage-one/stage-two categories and higher systolic-or-diastolic category.
Current PREVENT 7.5% risk pathway and lower-risk lifestyle trial for three to six months.
Different elevated-pressure and diagnostic boundaries; home/awake/24-hour/sleep thresholds.
Correct cuff dimensions, preparation, timed orthostatic measurements.
White-coat versus masked phenotypes and nocturnal level versus relative dipping.
No demonstrated reduction in death or major cardiovascular events from bedtime versus morning treatment in the studied primary-care population; do not infer universal benefit from nondipping alone.

editorialReviewProgress.nextWork: Risk-based initiation and targets, then lifestyle and drug treatment in continuous sequence.

limitations: Source checks are author verification, not independent clinician review.
Structural validation does not establish completeness or clinical accuracy.
